description: The re-run of the Expectation paper's evaluation (rerun-plan 2026-11), qwen3.8:27b: its recommended sampling for thinking (temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, top_k 20, min_p 0), max_tokens 32,768, thinking xhigh (config.json's, author 20 Nov 2026), traffic and top-up in stage 1, known data only. The prompts are pinned to the versions current at the re-run's start (Skuld 0.12.4: stage 1 and minimisation with Loki 0.5.0's screen descriptions by the family's own model, never cited, and stage 1 with up to 8 screenshots; D-37), dpv-purposes 2.3.1, the study's purpose map (extended after the run by `skuld purposes map`, rerun-plan §5 step 7). client.limits is per process and as wide as the gateway's rule (100 gemma4:31b, 272 qwen3.8:27b: 300 less Loki's 28 on catalyst); Ratatoskr 0.42.0's shared limit (RATATOSKR_SHARED_LIMITS in the machine file) keeps every process of the machine together within it (D-22, D-36).
